The '''Bloody Water''' is a sept of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]]. The sept hold is unknown. On their way to [[Alcair Dal]], [[Rand al'Thor]] and the [[Jindo]] are joined by other Taardad septs including the [[Nine Valleys]], [[Chumai]], [[Four Stones]], Bloody Water and [[Miadi]] septs.{{ref/book|4|57}}
